authorized: User explicitly requested both UV synchronization and independently trained camera textures followed by one-cloth deployment
shared_control: Reuse the three matched-reference final textures from the ongoing reference study; no texture selection

training.gradient_request: texture only, as numerically validated in the reference study
training.renderer: same frozen renderer; inherited user-authorized wrist-photometry exception; no recalibration
training.hardware_pairing: All seed-10 and seed-11 controls use RTX4090; all seed-12 controls use A100, matching the source GPU family of each shared-control texture.

arms.uv_ind: One shared texture; original main-camera UV stream; independent auxiliary wrist UV stream with identical marginals, one draw per batch. Same initialization, observation stream, parameters, source calls and deployment as shared control.
arms.main: Optimize one texture through the main view only; wrist receives a float32 cached same-path Plain rendering. Full 5000-update budget and original frame/UV stream.
arms.wrist: Optimize a separate texture through the wrist view only; main receives a float32 cached same-path Plain rendering. Full 5000-update budget and original frame/UV stream.

independent_pair_budget: Two textures and two complete training arms per seed: twice the parameters and source forward calls of shared training. This is an explicitly more generous independent-training baseline.

composition.raw: Pointwise UV-space Euclidean consensus Tbar=(Tm+Tw)/2, followed by fixed nearest-integer PNG export. This minimizes the sum of squared texture-space distances on the shared-texture diagonal, not rendered-image error.
composition.primary: Scale the mean perturbation about the fixed Plain RGB, clip to the original per-pixel epsilon and valid RGB range, and choose scale by source-texture RMS only to match the corresponding shared texture's exported RMS. Fixed bisection and nearest export; no target feedback.
composition.unreachable: Report the attainable RMS and retain the maximum-amplitude bounded consensus; never describe it as matched if the target RMS is infeasible.

evaluation.protocol: Identical native rendering, production Object placement, 400 actions, 10 settling steps, replan 5, denoise 10 and query-indexed Gaussian noise as reference-stability study
evaluation.reuse: Reuse 200 Plain and 600 shared matched-reference episodes by exact texture and protocol identity; do not rerun or select them

analysis.training_units: Three complete predeclared seed pairs; report all per-seed, per-suite and averaged differences, sample SD, t intervals and exact sign flips. Three pairs cannot yield a two-sided exact sign-flip p below 0.25; do not claim population-level significance from episode counts.
analysis.episode_tests: Conditional frozen-texture comparisons: exact paired McNemar with Holm across 12 primary contrast-by-seed-by-suite tests; raw-consensus six tests are a separate secondary family.
analysis.scope: Shared rendering is a subset of independently specified camera appearances. No claim of universal optimal-source-loss superiority, no claim that a UV-only contrast isolates all parameter-sharing effects.
analysis.selection: Keep every planned seed and final texture, regardless of outcomes. A negative or mixed comparison does not establish an advantage.
